roadmap_fit: Fresh market-neutral strategy-economic lane after PACK, rank-breadth reversal, and ATR shock-snapback; contract only, with no outcome access or activation.
hypothesis: Pairs of liquid crypto perpetuals whose log prices remain cointegrated in a strictly prior training window can exhibit temporary inventory-driven residual dislocations that mean-revert after paying both-leg execution costs and signed funding.

economic_distinction.from_pack: The signal is a beta-hedged two-instrument residual, not a directional pullback or momentum signal.
economic_distinction.from_rank_breadth_reversal: Pair membership and direction come from within-pair cointegration and residual distance, not cross-sectional return ranks or market breadth.
economic_distinction.from_atr_shock_snapback: Entry is a stationary relative-value deviation with two funded legs, not an absolute-price ATR shock in one symbol.
economic_distinction.primary_risk: Crypto relationships can break abruptly; selection error, two-leg execution, funding, and shared-symbol concentration can erase apparent mean reversion.

data_authority.entry_and_signal_exit_fill: next available 1h open after the completed decision bar
data_authority.exchange_filter_requirement: Use the protected point-in-time exchange-filter authority bound to the same universe version; fail closed if the authority, bar, mark-price, or funding coverage is missing.
data_authority.survivorship_rule: Membership is resolved at each selection instant from the point-in-time universe; current membership may never be projected backward.
data_authority.outcome_embargo: No C255 evaluation or sealed-holdout rows were read while freezing this contract.

walk_forward.parameter_policy: All thresholds are fixed here. Development may only reject the family; it may not tune or rescue it. A change creates a new numbered family.

pair_selection.regression: OLS log(y) on constant plus log(x), trained only in the trailing 180-day window
pair_selection.residual_stationarity: Engle-Granger residual ADF p-values are Holm-Bonferroni corrected across every eligible pair at that monthly selection; corrected alpha is 0.05.
pair_selection.stability: Both non-overlapping 90-day training halves must have raw residual ADF p<=0.05, positive beta, beta drift<=25%, and residual half-life within 6..72 hours.
pair_selection.selection_order: ascending corrected ADF p-value, then ascending half-life, then lexicographic y/x symbols
pair_selection.portfolio_pairs: Greedily take at most six pairs in selection order; each symbol may occur in at most one selected pair for the entire test month.
pair_selection.frozen_monthly_model: Pair identity, beta, residual mean, residual standard deviation, and all thresholds stay frozen throughout the test month.

signals.long_spread: At a completed 1h bar, z<=-2.5: buy y and sell beta-weighted x at the next 1h open.
signals.short_spread: At a completed 1h bar, z>=+2.5: sell y and buy beta-weighted x at the next 1h open.
signals.cost_floor: Absolute residual displacement must also be at least 0.014 log-price units, five times the 28 bp base four-fill pair round trip.
signals.signal_exit: After entry, first completed bar with abs(z)<=0.25 exits both legs at the next 1h open.
signals.residual_stop: After entry, first completed bar with abs(z)>=4.5 exits both legs at the next 1h open.
signals.catastrophic_leg_stop: Each leg has a reduce-only exchange stop three training-window ATRs from its entry; if either triggers, flatten the other leg at that bar's conservative executable price.
signals.ambiguity_policy: If a catastrophic stop and any favorable exit can occur in the same unresolved bar, book the stop first. Gap-through stops fill at the worse of stop and next executable open, plus adverse slippage.
forbidden: updating model statistics with test-month observations

position_and_portfolio.leg_weighting: Allocate pair gross notional between y and x in the ratio 1:abs(trained_beta), preserving the signal side on each leg.
position_and_portfolio.risk_unit: Size the pair so the modeled loss at the 4.5z residual stop is 1R, then cap down for catastrophic-leg stops and exchange filters.
position_and_portfolio.exchange_feasibility: Both legs must satisfy point-in-time tick, step, minimum quantity, and minimum notional after rounding at $1,000 and $4,000 account-capital simulations; otherwise skip before entry.
position_and_portfolio.atomicity: A pair is valid only if both legs can be placed. One-leg acceptance or an uncertain second leg is a failed entry requiring immediate bounded flatten and is never counted as a strategy trade.

costs.funding: Book actual signed Binance funding independently on both legs at every settlement, using the last causal verified mark-price close.
costs.market_impact: Report participation against causal quote volume; reject any trade exceeding 0.10% of the completed bar quote volume on either leg.
costs.all_gates_apply_to: base costs and stressed slippage, with actual funding and exchange rounding in both cases

development_immediate_reject: any missing causal bar, mark, funding, universe, or exchange-filter authority
forward_final_pass_all_required: at least 200 closed pair trades across at least 12 symbols and 6 distinct selected pairs
at least 2 of 3 forward folds have positive net R
long-spread and short-spread each have at least 50 trades and non-negative mean net R
no pair contributes more than 25% of absolute net R
at least 55% of test months have positive net R
stress-cost aggregate mean net R>0 and profit factor>1.02
all exchange-feasibility and causal-authority checks pass
uncertainty_report: mean net R with stationary block-bootstrap 95% confidence interval
fees, slippage, funding, and impact separately

falsification: Reject if any immediate development gate fails; do not open forward folds.
Reject if any final forward gate fails; do not tune, rescue, or inspect the sealed holdout.
Reject if profitability disappears under stressed slippage or after signed two-leg funding.
Reject if pair stationarity or membership uses observations at or after its monthly selection instant.
Reject if realistic two-leg exchange rules cannot be reproduced atomically in the protected testnet harness.
A rejection is final for C255 and advances the next preregistered family.

multiplicity.monthly_pair_selection_correction: Holm-Bonferroni at family alpha 0.05 across all eligible pairs
multiplicity.ledger_rule: Record every attempted family and pair-selection month, including empty selections and failures.
